summary: Revised clean-import renders read as a practical one-handed full-tang utility/fighting knife at a credible 0.4425 m overall length. The restrained silhouette, thin 6 mm blade stock, modest guard, contoured 0.118 m grip scales, exposed fasteners, and open lanyard eye support crude realism. Material separation is now visible: charcoal matte rubber grip, black-oxide tang/fittings, blue-grey satin steel blade body, and a lighter smoother ground edge. The exported GLB validates at 584 triangles, 10 mesh objects, 4 materials, zero degenerate polygons, with the root and three required attachment markers present.
